highMediumAll.subject: fix(models/auth): preserve primary when login omits --set-default
highMediumAll.finding: Medium: Raw model restore can undo `replaceDefaultModels` migrations
highMediumAll.summary: Found one compatibility regression in the new restore step. It preserves the old `agents.defaults.model` even when the provider patch is explicitly replacing/renaming the model allowlist, which can leave a legacy primary outside the rewritten allowlist.

highMediumAll.subject: test(extensions): type mocked calls explicitly
highMediumAll.finding: Medium: OpenRouter provider test assertion no longer matches the typed fixture
highMediumAll.summary: Found one concrete regression: the OpenRouter image generation test now fails because the new typed fixture includes `models: []`, but the expected mocked auth call was not updated to match the actual config forwarded by production code.

highMediumAll.subject: fix: abort generic no-progress tool loops
highMediumAll.finding: Medium: Generic loop blocks are not sticky after the first critical block
highMediumAll.summary: Found one reliability bug: the new generic critical loop block fires once, but an immediate retry of the same tool call is allowed because the blocked result is recorded into loop history and breaks the identical-outcome streak.

highMediumAll.subject: feat(tools): add per-sender tool policies (#66933)
highMediumAll.finding: Medium: Channel-scoped group sender policies are ignored in plugin-owned group adapters
highMediumAll.summary: Found one actionable issue. The new `channel:<channelId>:<senderId>` sender-key support works in the generic resolver, but several plugin-owned group policy adapters still call `resolveToolsBySender` without a channel/provider value, so channel-scoped group policies silently miss.

highMediumAll.subject: test: verify auto-reply payloads
highMediumAll.finding: Medium: New metadata assertion fails core test typecheck
highMediumAll.summary: Found one concrete test typecheck regression. Runtime Vitest passes, but the repo’s core test tsgo lane fails on the changed assertion.

highMediumAll.subject: fix: add channel status filtering (#80706)
highMediumAll.finding: Medium: Stopped-Gateway migration probe cannot produce live iMessage probe results
highMediumAll.summary: Found three actionable issues: one medium docs/runtime mismatch in the BlueBubbles migration path, one low CLI fallback bug for invalid filters, and one low compatibility risk in the generated Swift protocol init.

highMediumAll.subject: fix: Fix the build: annotate provider-http test-helper exports for portable dts (#80781)
highMediumAll.finding: Medium: SDK provider HTTP mock helper now fails lint
highMediumAll.summary: The commit fixes portable declaration typing for provider HTTP test helpers, but introduces a lint regression in the public SDK test helper.

highMediumAll.subject: fix(codex): scale context engine projection (#80761)
highMediumAll.finding: Medium: Floor-only reserve config removes Codex projection headroom
highMediumAll.summary: Found one concrete regression in the new Codex context projection reserve mapping. The main scaling fix works in the focused tests, but a floor-only compaction config is now interpreted as the whole projection reserve instead of as a floor guard.

highMediumAll.subject: fix: reintroduce partial-fragment drop for clean timeouts
highMediumAll.finding: Medium: Completed timeout-edge replies can be discarded as partial fragments
highMediumAll.summary: Found one plausible regression in the timeout payload synthesis. The new partial-fragment drop treats any non-empty assistant text on a prompt timeout as partial, even when the attempt has a completed assistant message.

highMediumAll.subject: fix(docker): avoid external Dockerfile frontend pull
highMediumAll.finding: Medium: Root Dockerfile can fail on older bundled Dockerfile frontends
highMediumAll.summary: Found one compatibility regression risk: removing the external Dockerfile frontend pin makes the root Dockerfile depend on the builder’s bundled frontend, but the file still uses `RUN --mount` variable expansion that older Dockerfile frontends do not support.

highMediumAll.subject: fix(imessage): surface Full Disk Access probe failures
highMediumAll.finding: Medium: EPIPE can still hide stored Full Disk Access diagnostics
highMediumAll.summary: Found one remaining failure path in the iMessage RPC client: the new public Full Disk Access diagnostic is only used when the child `close` handler rejects pending requests. If an earlier stdin/write EPIPE path wins the race, health still receives a generic EPIPE and can omit the failed probe from non-sensitive status output.

highMediumAll.subject: Enforce inline shell wrapper payload matching [AI] (#80978)
highMediumAll.finding: Medium: Shell multiplexer allowlist entries still bypass inline payload matching
highMediumAll.summary: The commit hardens inline shell-wrapper approval, but the new guard still lets a bare `busybox` or `toybox` allowlist entry approve arbitrary shell applet payloads without evaluating the extracted `sh -c` command.

highMediumAll.subject: fix: detect carried exec command forms [AI] (#81000)
highMediumAll.finding: High: Unquoted `$*` positional carriers still bypass strict inline-eval approval
highMediumAll.summary: The commit adds recursive inline-eval detection for shell positional carriers, but it still misses an allowlisted unquoted `$*` carrier that the allowlist accepts as direct positional argv. In strict inline-eval mode, that leaves a command-executing `find -exec` form approval-free when the carried executable is already allowlisted.

highMediumAll.subject: fix: harden safe-bin argument validation [AI] (#80999)
highMediumAll.finding: Medium: Nested safe-bin chain rewrite literalizes allowlisted segments too
highMediumAll.summary: Found one concrete regression in the new nested inline-chain rewrite path. The safe-bin hardening is broadly scoped correctly, and the targeted tests pass, but nested `sh -c` chains that mix explicit allowlist commands with safe-bin commands can now silently execute different argv for the allowlisted segment.
